tickets.summary: K-3401 NDE bearing vibration rose from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s in six weeks; growing 1x and sidebands remain below alarm but have not plateaued, threatening the sole export-compressor train.
tickets.recommended_action: Rotating-equipment specialist to diagnose NDE vibration and set disposition; repair as indicated and verify a stable below-alarm trend. Assess personnel/release exposure. Check current vibration and operation. Diagnose NDE vibration cause. Obtain source-required attention today.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The continuing six-week rise, growing spectral components and absence of a plateau provide strong progression evidence, although vibration remains below alarm and function loss is not confirmed.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would stop the single export-compressor train with no spare or workaround, sending the platform to recycle and cutting production within an hour; this supports severe operational impact.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first weekly-test start, then started after ~8 s at 22.8 V and made rated pressure; FW-8101 later made 9.2/11 barg with flow unmeasured.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire-protection authority: approve operating/repair disposition; correct faults confirmed by tests. Check deviation record. Check fire-demand exposure basis. Retest first-start and rated pressure. Test FW-8101 pressure and flow. Test battery, air and start circuit.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The required demand-start function failed once during an actual function test. Subsequent starting and rated pressure indicate intermittent rather than persistent total failure, supporting 9 rather than 10.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes one safety-critical firewater pump on demand. FW-8101 is the N+1 partner, but its later test showed 9.2 barg against 11 barg with flow unmeasured, so backup capability cannot be credited or total firewater loss asserted.

tickets.summary: PL-1002 has wet CUI and heavy scaling at window 2 by the low-point drain; UT is 6.2 mm versus 7.4 mm minimum on a live full-wellhead-pressure hydrocarbon line.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of pressure containment could release hydrocarbons from a 6-inch flowline at full wellhead pressure. No redundancy is listed, supporting severe impact; exposure details do not support an extreme score.

tickets.summary: P-3305 tripped three times this month; wellhead-manifold inhibitor injection was intermittent for about 10 days. A diaphragm fault is suspected, risking downstream corrosion within weeks.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Required inhibitor injection has already been interrupted repeatedly, with three trips this month and intermittent delivery for about ten days. The function loss is confirmed, although the suspected diaphragm cause is unverified.

tickets.summary: LB-4102 release gear was notchy and required force above specification; class withheld certification and declared the port freefall lifeboat unavailable, reducing evacuation capacity.
tickets.recommended_action: Overhaul release gear under class/surveyor control; test force to specification and obtain recertification. Verify availability and capability of LB-4101. Verify current LB-4102 class status. Verify current POB against certified available evacuation capacity.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Declared unavailability and withheld certification directly confirm failure of LB-4102's required certified launch and evacuation function.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes certified evacuation capacity during an emergency, creating severe personnel exposure. The N+1 reference is not credited because LB-4101 capability and capacity against POB are unverified; extreme impact is therefore not asserted.

tickets.summary: PSV-3420’s certification tag is illegible from corrosion, but the register shows March 2025 recertification in date and the valve appears sound; relief-function loss is not demonstrated.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect PSV-3420; authorized pressure-systems engineer to replace tag. Match valve ID and verify 2-year status. Review compressor relief consequence basis.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The in-date recertification and satisfactory observed condition provide little indication of near-term loss of compressor-discharge relief function.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the sole SCE PSV would remove compressor-discharge overpressure protection, creating severe major-accident exposure; scenario details do not support the extreme band.

tickets.summary: Firewater pump A stabilized at 9.2 barg versus 11 barg; flow was not measured. Duty may be impaired, possibly by pump wear or a partly closed test-line valve, but full function loss is unconfirmed.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire protection engineer to set disposition and correct confirmed faults. Confirm test acceptance criteria. Function-test FW-8102 capability. Inspect pump/test-line hydraulics. Retest pressure and required flow. Verify fire demand and personnel exposure. Verify or record impairment deviation.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The 9.2 barg result against 11 barg is meaningful deficient performance. Successful first start, normal engine parameters, unmeasured flow and an uncertain hydraulic cause prevent confirmed function failure or top-band likelihood.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure to deliver required firewater would degrade a safety-critical protection layer in the scenario the fire-protection philosophy is designed to avoid. The N+1 partner's current capability is unverified, supporting severe but not evidenced extreme impact.

tickets.summary: Second-stage discharge-line cladding is loose and flapping, confirming loss of secure retention and creating a dropped-object hazard without an identified process concern.
tickets.recommended_action: Mechanical authority to control the drop zone, inspect cladding/supports, approve repair, correct findings and verify secure retention. Inspect cladding supports and attachments. Survey cladding and drop-zone exposure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Visual observation confirms loss of secure retention. Complete detachment has not yet occurred, supporting 9 rather than 10.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Detachment would create a credible dropped-object injury hazard. No process concern is identified, while unknown cladding mass, drop height and personnel exposure prevent tighter consequence definition.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v2: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=9, I=6, base=7, final=7.
